verdict.rationale: Rippling is an HR/IT/finance SaaS platform, so outbound webhooks are a fair axis, but nothing in the evidence documents registrable outbound HTTP callbacks. The evidence covers only custom workflows that notify people, Slack-alert automations, general APIs and a CLI. None of these is a webhook subscription mechanism a programmatic consumer can receive.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can subscribe to events via webhooks
